title: [AUG-172] Research: resizable Default Prompt field in Settings
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 1): the Default Prompt field (transcript processing instructions with {sessionName}, {date}, {duration}) is too small — the whole prompt cannot be seen. Users want to drag the bottom edge to expand it. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Current field described with file:line refs (component, CSS, height limits) and every place the same prompt editor is used.
- [ ] Options compared: vertical resize handle, auto-grow to content with max height, expand-to-modal — with trade-offs; whether the chosen height should persist.
- [ ] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-172/default-prompt.html (opens in a browser, no build) with a working interactive demo of each option (drag handle, auto-grow, expand) using a long real prompt; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [ ] Recommendation given; the user picks an option on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [ ] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. Brutalist design: 0 border-radius (see frontend-design route). Roadmap: M1 Quick fixes. Order: 3/10.

## Findings (2026-11-04)
- Default editor textarea @client/src/components/PraxisProjectsPage.tsx:407 sits directly in `.praxis-md-detail`, not in `.praxis-md-field--grow` → no flex:1 / min-height → browser default 2 rows (~52px measured in mockup).
- `.praxis-md-textarea { resize: none }` (@client/src/App.css:7458) overrides `.settings-textarea { resize: vertical }` (App.css:7367) → no drag.
- Same editor pattern: per-project Prompt textarea PraxisProjectsPage.tsx:523 inside `--grow` (App.css:7456-7457, flex:1, min-height 120px) → fills the pane, not resizable. Shared: renderChips/insertVariable with one promptRef (L44, L272, L289).
- Limits: Settings card 600px wide (App.css:6975), Projects tab 85vh (App.css:7429), list column 210px → pane ≈390px wide.
- No other prompt editors (Send to Praxis modal only shows a prompt note).

## Options
- A · Drag handle (6px, Ghost Caption pattern): user control, but range capped by the 85vh modal; needs persisted height + keyboard separator.
- B · Fill + auto-grow: wrap in `--grow` like the project editor; 1 JSX + CSS fix; no persistence; long prompts scroll.
- C · Fill + Expand: B + full-window editor overlay (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+E); whole prompt visible; one new overlay component.

## Decision (user, 2026-11-04): B + C
Mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-172/default-prompt.html. Height not persisted.
Implementation task: AUG-191-vypg2x.
